description: List the folders and files directly under a folder in one of the user's connected buckets, to find the path for a storage://<id>/<path> job input. Every entry carries its ready-made uri. Pass a folder's prefix to go one level deeper, and the returned cursor to read the next page. Read-only: it never changes the bucket. Requires a configured API key with storage access.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page

limit.description: Entries per page, up to 1000. Defaults to 100. Use the returned cursor to fetch the next page.

prefix.description: Folder to list, ending in '/', e.g. 'raw/2026/'. Omit for the top of the bucket.

name: list_storage_files

cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

title: List Files in Connected Storage
